headword: {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}

definitions.gloss: high-rise building — a tall building with many stories; also, the construction of such buildings
definitions.explanation: A tall building with many floors — typically an office tower, condominium, hotel, or public building. Also refers to the activity or industry of constructing such buildings. In Japan the term is often used more or less interchangeably with {高層|こうそう}ビル, though {高層建築|こうそうけんちく} has a slightly more technical or formal ring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many high-rise buildings in the city center.

examples.japanese: {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}く→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: High-rise buildings are designed to be earthquake-resistant.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: With the redevelopment in front of the station, new high-rise buildings are being built one after another.

examples.japanese: {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戦後|せんご}→戦後：12853_sengo⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発展|はってん}した→発展する：25331_hattensuru⟧。
examples.english: High-rise construction technology developed rapidly after the war.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ ('many-storied, high-rise') and ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ ('building, architecture, construction').

USAGE:
- Used both for the buildings themselves and for the act or field of constructing them, e.g., {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧ ('high-rise construction technology').
- In Japanese legal and technical usage, buildings over 60 meters are often formally classed as ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ ('super-high-rise'); the boundary between ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧ and ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧ is not universally fixed.
- Widely used in news, architecture, urban planning, and real estate contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}つ→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧: a high-rise is built/goes up
- {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{建設|けんせつ}→建設：02708_kensetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to construct a high-rise
- {高層建築|こうそうけんちく}{物|ぶつ}: high-rise structure (another, more formal variant)
- ⟦{都市|とし}→都市：01477_toshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{高層建築|こうそうけんちく}: urban high-rise buildings

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高層|こうそう}ビル→高層ビル：16994_kousoubiru⟧: high-rise (office) building — the everyday conversational equivalent.
- ⟦{超高層|ちょうこうそう}→超高層：26197_choukousou⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: super-high-rise / skyscraper — for especially tall buildings, often 100 m+.
- ⟦{低層|ていそう}→低層：21924_teisou⟧⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: low-rise building — the direct antonym.
- {中層|ちゅうそう}⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧: mid-rise building — for buildings of intermediate height.
- ⟦{建築|けんちく}{物|ぶつ}→建築物：21292_kenchikubutsu⟧: building, structure — the general term for any building.
